info.description:
bank is one person's archive: messages (mail, chats, AI conversations), a media
library with what was watched, listened to and read, files, and published notes. The
file catalogue of disks that come and go is served below /attic, with a document of
its own at /attic/openapi.json.

Cite a message as bank:<ref>, a library record by its ID, and a file on a disk as
attic:<ref>.

Uploads, imports and byte downloads are not in this document yet.

The answer names the record, the route that returns it in full, and where the same bytes are in the other store: a message attachment's copies on disks, or the messages and library files that hold a disk file's bytes. Those links appear once the server has read the blob's BLAKE3 digest, shortly after an import.
